title: Gnome World: Which Parts Are Hazel
blurb: Which parts of Gnome world are Hazel and which JavaScript, then (0.0.103, 11-24) and now (0.0.148, 11-27). Then Hazel decided 2 of the 12 parts of a step, the gnome's step and the beavers'; now 7 of 16: every way the gnome moves, the boulders, picking things up, the wind, and the bunnies', frogs' and birds' minds, each moved in its own module and checked against the JavaScript it replaced at every step. Hazel's code nearly doubled (40,213 characters to 74,118), but the JavaScript grew too, mostly drawing, so its share of the code went only from 8% to 10%. In Hazel, compiled by hazel-jit, each piece takes 1.9 to 6.6 times its JavaScript's time a call, at most about 4 µs; and since 0.0.147 the rules are compiled ahead of time, ready in 0.2 s instead of 4 to 16.
